summary: The cleanup is what it claims. Main's required check is exactly CI Check from the Actions app (15368), and the one job with that name lives in aurora-ci-minimal.yml, which the range does not touch. The four retired workflows were echo-only, disabled or receipt-only duplicates; no workflow, test or required check consumes their names (the two workflow_run consumers use a wildcard). k8s-deploy.yml and the canonical receipt gate are unchanged, and hosted logs show Run Tests verifying the exact checkout on both the PR merge commit and fe99f3e5. Constellation keeps its blocking type check and advisory audit, lint and build with all four artifacts, now from one install, and my mutation checks show the new tests catch a re-added install and a blocking audit. The workflow map matches the 37 files exactly, the simulation tree is unchanged, and the root pins agree. Notes only: several maintained AI/developer docs still describe the retired workflows (f1), an unwired generator can re-emit branch-protection.yml (f2), and the simulation freshness guard stays red on main with its tracking issue closed (f3).
